content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NaBFID Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 20-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the National Bank for Financing Infrastructure and Development (NaBFID) for hiring qualified professionals on a contract basis across India.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post announced under this recruitment notification is Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) within the banking and financial technology sector.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) post in this recruitment notification cycle.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 20 October 2026 by 06:00 pm IST. Applicants must send their materials on time.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode?
faq.answer: The mode of application is through Email. Interested candidates must send their detailed CVs to the designated recruitment email address.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an Engineering Graduate or Post-Graduate degree in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, Cyber Security fields, or MCA from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 55 years and below as specified in the recruitment advertisement for the CISO position.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises screening and shortlisting based on eligibility, personal interviews, and optional psychometric tests or assessment centres.

faq.question: Q9. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: No application fee details are mentioned in the official notification, meaning candidates can submit their applications without fee payments.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the official website?
faq.answer: You can visit the official website of NaBFID at https://nabfid.org to access detailed notifications, updates, and further announcements regarding this hiring process.
